benchmarks.name: CEdit-Bench-EN overall (G_O, GPT-4o judge)
benchmarks.description: CEdit-Bench (introduced in the LongCat-Image report: 1,464 bilingual editing pairs across 15 task categories), English instructions, overall score G_O on the 0–10 VLM-judge scale (GPT-4o), divided by 10. Not GEdit-Bench.

benchmarks.name: CEdit-Bench-CN overall (G_O, GPT-4o judge)
benchmarks.description: CEdit-Bench Chinese-instruction track, overall score G_O on the 0–10 VLM-judge scale (GPT-4o), divided by 10. Separate from the English track.

benchmarks.name: OmniContext average (GPT-4.1 judge)
benchmarks.description: OmniContext (introduced in the OmniGen2 report): in-context, subject-driven generation from reference images over eight subtasks (single, multiple and scene; character, object and both). Average of the subtask overall scores (geometric mean of prompt following and subject consistency, GPT-4.1 judge, 0–10), divided by 10.

benchmarks.name: Seed-TTS test-zh · speaker similarity (ERes2Net SV)
benchmarks.description: Zero-shot voice cloning on Seed-TTS-Eval test-zh; cosine similarity of ERes2Net speaker-verification embeddings between generated and reference speech. Kept apart from the WavLM-based seed-tts-zh-wavlm-sim.

benchmarks.name: Seed-TTS test-en · speaker similarity (ERes2Net SV)
benchmarks.description: Zero-shot voice cloning on Seed-TTS-Eval test-en; cosine similarity of ERes2Net speaker-verification embeddings between generated and reference speech. Kept apart from the WavLM-based seed-tts-en-wavlm-sim.
